title: Informational Ontology: Universe as W(3,3) Computation Over Photons
thesis: Universe is a 21-bit program over a photon register indexed by W(3,3) edges; time=computation, space=graph distance, constants=automorphism invariants

ontology.photon: single edge e in E, helicity +/-1
ontology.graviton: TT closure of full edge set
ontology.dark_matter: zero-charge stabilizer orbit at Frobenius fixed point
ontology.Higgs: scalar density of q=3 spanning tree
